note: Every new prompt is a prompt this batch caused, and every API call the run made was a prompt the cache did not hold. The count of new prompts is at or above the call count rather than equal to it, for two reasons that are both one directional: a prompt new to this sample may still have been cached from an earlier session, and the name harvest and short unit paths call the engine without writing to this file. So what is asserted is that the ledger identity holds, that the new prompts cover the calls, and that not one new prompt is unattributed.
